description.zh:
激活码用于注册迁移源的使用次数上限。取值范围为1~1000。

默认值为100。
description.en:
The maximum number of times that the activation code can be used to register migration sources. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

Default value: 100.
The description of the activation code.

description.zh: 激活码名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the activation code. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with http\:// or https\://. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
激活码的有效使用时间，过期后将不能用于注册新的实例。单位：天。取值范围为1~90。

默认值为30。
description.en:
The validity period of the activation code, in days. The activation code cannot be used to register new instances after it expires. Valid values: 1 to 90.

Default value: 30.

descriptions.zh: 如果您使用激活码导入迁移源，需使用此接口创建激活码。
descriptions.en: If you need an activation code to import a migration source, call this operation to create one.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc create-access-token --name test_name --description '这是导入迁移源激活码' --count 10 --time-to-live-in-days 30 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun smc CreateAccessToken --region cn-hangzhou --Description '这是导入迁移源激活码' --Count 10 --TimeToLiveInDays 30 --Name test_name
